35template <std::size_t N, typename T = int>
36struct dim
37{

40 constexpr dim() = default;
41
42 // Constructor from N arguments
43 template <typename... Args>
44 requires(sizeof...(Args) == N)
45 constexpr dim(Args... args) : data{static_cast<T>(args)...}
46 {
47 }
48
49 constexpr T &operator[](std::size_t i) { return data[i]; }
50 constexpr const T &operator[](std::size_t i) const { return data[i]; }
51};
